title: Improved Bounds for Restricted-Tweak Rekeying
summary: Existing security bounds permit unrestricted tweak reuse; the open task is to derive improved security bounds when each tweak has an explicit maximum number of appearances.

formal_statement.body: For rekeying constructions $R1$, $R2$, and $R3$, existing security bounds do not impose a limit on how many times a user may use a given tweak; determine improved security bounds when each tweak is restricted to an explicit maximum number of appearances.

scope.domain: Security analysis of rekeying constructions in symmetric cryptography.
parameters: R1, R2, and R3 rekeying constructions
maximum number of appearances allowed for each tweak
scope.unresolved_remainder: Derive the improved security bounds under an explicit maximum on the number of appearances of each tweak.

citations.label: Beyond Birthday Bound Secure Fresh Rekeying: Application to Authenticated Encryption

progress.summary: The source notes that the bounds of Theorems 1-3 can be improved when the number of appearances per tweak is restricted, presenting this as an unresolved direction for stronger bounds.
citation_labels: Bart Mennink et al., Beyond Birthday Bound Secure Fresh Rekeying: Application to Authenticated Encryption
